name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.9, 3.10, 3.11, 3.12]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install uv
        run: pip install uv

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --dev

      - name: Run tests
        run: pytest

  test-generated-project:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        db: [tortoise, beanie]
        docker: [true, false]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: 3.11

      - name: Install cookiecutter and uv
        run: |
          pip install cookiecutter uv

      - name: Generate project
        run: |
          mkdir generated
          cookiecutter . \
            --no-input \
            --extra-context '{"project_name":"testproj","db":"${{ matrix.db }}","docker":"${{ matrix.docker }}"}' \
            --output-dir generated

      - name: Check file structure
        run: |
          PROJECT_DIR=generated/testproj
          # Basic file checks
          for file in README.md pyproject.toml main.py app/__init__.py; do
            if [ ! -f "$PROJECT_DIR/$file" ]; then
              echo "Missing required file: $file"
              exit 1
            fi
          done

      - name: Check Python syntax
        run: |
          find generated/testproj -name '*.py' -exec python -m py_compile {} +

      - name: Check for unreplaced template variables
        run: |
          if grep -R '{{cookiecutter' generated/testproj; then
            echo "Unreplaced template variables found"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Install dependencies with uv
        run: |
          cd generated/testproj
          uv sync || true

      - name: Basic module imports
        run: |
          cd generated/testproj
          python -c "import main; import app"

yaml:
name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.9, 3.10, 3.11, 3.12]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install uv
        run: pip install uv

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --dev

      - name: Run tests
        run: pytest

  test-generated-project:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        db: [tortoise, beanie]
        docker: [true, false]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: 3.11

      - name: Install cookiecutter and uv
        run: |
          pip install cookiecutter uv

      - name: Generate project
        run: |
          mkdir generated
          cookiecutter . \
            --no-input \
            --extra-context '{"project_name":"testproj","db":"${{ matrix.db }}","docker":"${{ matrix.docker }}"}' \
            --output-dir generated

      - name: Check file structure
        run: |
          PROJECT_DIR=generated/testproj
          # Basic file checks
          for file in README.md pyproject.toml main.py app/__init__.py; do
            if [ ! -f "$PROJECT_DIR/$file" ]; then
              echo "Missing required file: $file"
              exit 1
            fi
          done

      - name: Check Python syntax
        run: |
          find generated/testproj -name '*.py' -exec python -m py_compile {} +

      - name: Check for unreplaced template variables
        run: |
          if grep -R '{{cookiecutter' generated/testproj; then
            echo "Unreplaced template variables found"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Install dependencies with uv
        run: |
          cd generated/testproj
          uv sync || true

      - name: Basic module imports
        run: |
          cd generated/testproj
          python -c "import main; import app"
